title: The Almsgiving
logline: A family has been up since before dawn to cook for the monks. One person arranges every plate beautifully, one checks for mistakes, one waits to be told, one keeps drifting off to talk, and one quietly wonders whether any of it matters.
human_question: Why do people who share the same work find their way through it so differently?

premise.story: A real household's preparation for a merit-making almsgiving, from the night before to the moment the monks leave. The film watches each family member's way of doing the same work, and listens if one of them openly doubts.
premise.place: A village home on almsgiving day: smoke from the kitchen, mats spread, the best plates out, relatives arriving.
premise.experience: Warm, crowded and intimate; the viewer recognises people they know in how each one works.

concept_links.why: Margaya's traits (doing things beautifully, noticing faults, following others, talking a lot and drifting) show up in ordinary shared work [C086-M:L9–L19]. Everyone has all these leanings; no family member is presented as a type.

Margaya names doubt about the results of good deeds and about rebirth, and says good done with doubt is not strong good [C008-M:L5; C008-M:L16]. The film may observe hesitation only if a family member genuinely voices it.
The source notes pride slipping into generosity itself, wanting one's offering to look better than a neighbour's. If it happens, a camera can catch it without naming it.

what_camera_could_observe: Cooking through the night; the kitchen at 4 a.m.
Each person's way of handling the same tasks
Remarks, jokes and silences while working
The monks arriving, the offering, the chanting
Clearing up, and the family finally sitting down to eat
what_must_be_real: The family, their almsgiving and their words. Doubt, disagreement or pride must never be prompted or staged, and no one is edited into a caricature.

possible_arc.turn: The pressure of the arrival time; differences between people show.
possible_arc.ending_open: After the monks leave. Whatever the family actually says to each other ends the film.

requirements: A family already planning an almsgiving in the filming window
Every adult in the family consents to being filmed

suggestions.name: A village in Kurunegala district
suggestions.why: A large farming district with many village temples and household almsgivings.
suggestions.verify: Region-level suggestion; a specific family must be found.

risks: Presenting a doubting relative as the villain, or the believers as models
Mapping family members onto temperament labels
drop_if: The family is uncomfortable with any disagreement being filmed

connections.note: A private, devotional rush set against a public commercial one.
Different leanings seen in shared work here; the teacher's attempt to fit practice to one person's leaning there.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
